notes.title: Lunar Union Event - Rewards Delivery
notes.notes:
Hello, Castaways!

We’ve discovered a bug that prevents players from retrieving items after completing the Lunar Union Festival missions. We know how frustrating this can be, especially after all the effort you’ve put into the event, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. 

To solve this issue, we’ll be [b]delivering the missing items through the Frog Box[/b]—a special mailbox in the game that distributes rewards and other goodies to all players. If you don’t already have a Frog Box, simply speak to Frogboy and he’ll give you one.

You’ll have from [i]February 12th until March 11th[/i] to retrieve your rewards from the Frog Box. After that date, the mail will expire, so please make sure to collect your items before then. We wouldn’t want you to miss out!

If you encounter any issues or have questions, feel free to reach out to us here or on Discord.

Thank you so much for your patience and for being part of our community. Your support means the world to us, and we’re committed to making Ikonei Island the best it can be for all Castaways.

notes.title: New Update Coming Thursday 13th Feb - Achievement Fixes!
notes.notes:
[h1][b] 🏝️ Hey Castaways! 🐸 [/b][/h1]

[h3]We hope you are enjoying the re-release of Lunar New Year! ːsteamhappyː[/h3]

That good vibes we have had from so many of you after this has been super heartening and I'm delighted to be able to announce that the long overdue fix update we have been working on is ready and...

We are releasing the update on 13 Feb! 

...and to celebrate we will have a daily 'Froggy Bonus' - just check your Frog Box every day for a cheeky bonus from your favourite Frogboy! 🐸from 13th to 19th Feb!


[u][b]What has been fixed:[/b][/u]

Flowers no longer respawn - [b]fixed.[/b]
Companion needs drop too fast - [b]fixed.[/b] Hunger and Cleanliness now drop much slower, however, Love (petting the creatures) still goes down at the same rate as before. Regardless of this minor issue, the game already feels a lot better and caring for the creatures is more balanced now.
"Advisor" achievement -[b] fixed[/b]
Mechanophobia - [b]fixed the achievement[/b]
Fixer Upper - [b]fixed the achievement[/b]

Additionally, there are a number of Achievement Settings we are going to adjust:

Busy Bibi - Pollinated 300 plants (changed from 1000)
Decorator - Placed 300 items (changed from 1000)
Digging It - Dug up 300 items (changed from 1000)

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]🛠️ Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]🖌️Art [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted colors for better enemy progressions
[*] New enemy type: Vipeagon
[*] Added tutorial images for new onboarding
[*] Easter outfit
[*] Easter placeable assets
[*] Easter plant
[*] Minor VFX tweaks
[*] Minor shader fixes
[*] Visual bug fixes
[*] Optimisation on ground shader
[/list]
[h3][b]💻 Code[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Features:
[list]
[*] New region rating system
[*] Tutorial popups
[*] The guiding orb
[*] Perspective toggle
[*] Puzzle system
[*] Mailbox system
[*] New cutscene system
[*] Pause mechanic
[*] Sprinklers
[/list]
[*] Tweaks:
[list][*] Combat
[list][*] Monsters now have slightly varying health.
[*] Player characters will now in some cases be left with half a heart from attacks that would otherwise defeat them.
[*] The forward momentum of attacks is now scaled with the velocity of the player character.
[*] Monsters can now damage each other. Sometimes there might break out between monsters.
[*] Monsters can now alert each other of nearby player characters.
[*] Placement mode
[*] Player characters can now move while in placement mode. 
[*] Direction that the placement mode spline pans is now based on whether the player character is picking up an item or dropping an item. [/list]
[*] Shops
[list][*] Shops now restock right away when a shop state is updated. The player no longer needs to go to sleep to get the latest added stock. [/list]
[*] Workorders
[list][*] Workorders now have a visual light beam to indicate that it is active.
[*] Daler can now be awarded for completing workorders. [/list]
[*] General player character
[list][*] Player characters are now invulnerable during cutscenes.[/list]
[*] Companions
[list][*] Companions can now be summoned via a summon interaction on a sleeping companion.
[*] Companions now walk up to the player character when they are ready to evolve. 
[*] Evolving a creature is now done via an interaction. [/list]
[*] UI
[list][*] Changing the zoom level of the map can now be done with the scroll wheel.[/list]
[*] Island Ratings
[list][*] The rating for decorating your island now uses a flexible evaluation that takes multiple factors into account to determine a final score
[*] New activity types have been added - Farming, Slaying Monsters, and rebuilding NPC buildings [/list]
[*] Crafting
[list][*] Input items can now be removed from in-progress refining stations[/list]
[*] Gardening
[list][*] Can water sand directly instead of plants
[*] Watering Cans now show a preview for range[/list]
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]🎨 Design[/b][/h3]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/f101ac5f1e45f6be126949b733e12fff858192ea.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[b][h1]Hello there, Castaways! 🏝️[/h1][/b]

So, as you probably noticed, Ikonei Island had a bit of a rocky start here on Steam. Some sneaky bugs managed to slip through the cracks despite all the testing we threw at it. We took that hard, but stepped up and have been hustling to squash those issues.

On the upside, we've managed to roll out not one but two seasonal updates – Lystide during the 2023 Holiday season and, today, Lunar New Year. We really hope you're enjoying the new stuff and grabbing those goodies.

Now, here's the real talk. It's clear to us that there are more improvements that we need to deliver, many inspired by the amazing feedback we have had from your guys. We have things we need to do to make sure the game really delivers on its potential. That's why we're holding off a bit on the PlayStation and Xbox releases. We're working on it and getting extremely close! The updates include significant improvements to usability (UX/UI), onboarding as well as more seasonal content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/2e71d0634450fd3d15d8315e8ce7b38b26fa7186.png[/img]

We were hoping to announce a confirmed release date today, but we don't want to make promises until everything's locked down. Console releases are like putting together a complex puzzle, and we're making sure all the pieces fit just right.

We know many of you will be super disappointed, but we're not about to deliver anything less than awesome. The improvements and new content we've thrown your way so far are just a glimpse of what's coming. Our aim is to launch on console with all the upgrades and cool stuff by the end of March.
We will share a much more detailed breakdown of the improvements (coming to PC as well) and a confirmed release date in the next few weeks.

In the meantime, here is a small taste of what some of the new UI assets will look like - let us know what you think!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/e27bdf061de4b0b783410727953eeaaeff82128e.png[/img]

notes.title: Year-End Recap & Important Updates For Our Snowcastle Community
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello there, Castaways! 🏝️[/h1][/b]

[b]As we approach the end of the year, it's time to reflect on the milestones we've achieved together and share some important updates.[/b]

[h2][b]🎉 Ikonei Island Launched on Steam and Epic[/b][/h2]

We're thrilled to announce the successful launch of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550730/Ikonei_Island_An_Earthlock_Adventure/]Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure[/url][/b] on November 9th, now available on both Steam and Epic platforms. We worked hard to implement the “Friends’ Pass”, which also functions as a demo! The [b]“[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1550730/discussions/0/3948028800075910873/]Friends’ Pass[/url]”[/b] allows a group of up to 4 players to play indefinitely on the host’s island, provided the host owns the game. We hope this fosters a sense of community and collaboration among players. 

We are not done with Ikonei Island yet - [b]On December 14th, Ikonei is celebrating “Lystide”!
Players will be visited by “The Spirit of Lystide Past” - so make sure to check out the Hamlet![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/a169e38a74f42c826116f329d5bceb46bdcf3c7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/06cbfd70ed93f37d1bf4d5f12b679ce47a271211.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Your support has been instrumental in making this launch a success, and we're excited to continue building and expanding Ikonei Island in the coming months.

[h2][b]🌱 Earthlock's Epic Store Free Week[/b][/h2]

Our first title, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/761030/EARTHLOCK/]Earthlock[/url][/b], was originally released in 2018. We have seen a huge boost in activity since it was available for free on the Epic Store for a week in November. Over 5.9 million people claimed the game! We hope you enjoyed revisiting the world of Earthlock. Be sure to check out our comics on Steam and Epic if you want to delve further into the Earthlock lore.

[h2][b]🏜️ Earthlock 2 Updates[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/edf30162d71cd0e1985c189d0cacde7ca2245b16.png[/img]

Our team made the choice to switch Earthlock 2 from Unity to Unreal Engine a couple of years ago. This has been a huge undertaking, and we have learned a lot about the engine, and the way we work as a studio. Another major challenge we have taken on is working on our first multiplayer game in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550730/Ikonei_Island_An_Earthlock_Adventure/]Ikonei Island[/url]. We have grown as a studio tackling these challenges, but it has cost us more time than initially anticipated.

However, for the last year, we have gone back to pre-production working on the core vision, and redesigned the main concept for the game. We feel we have something really good now, and we have been presenting this to publishers and investors lately. [b][url=https://twitter.com/snowcastlegames/status/1730559440892342606]We even won an award for the most anticipated game at an investor event in Malta at the end of November.[/url][/b] 

We are working on making this vision presentable to the community soon and will reveal the new launch date to you in the future. [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/826640/EARTHLOCK_2/]Wishlist Earthlock 2[/url][/b] to keep an eye out for the new features and more updates about the development process going forward!

notes.notes:
[h1]We got off to a bit of a rocky start. [/h1]

There is no other way to put it. Quite a few bugs surfaced during the first weekend that somehow months and months of QA testing hadn't found. [b]I would like to apologize to everyone for this![/b]

We have been so grateful for amazing reviews whilst we were in Early access. So it's hard to express the impact which hit all of us on the team when we started seeing our reviews going  from ‘Very Positive' (between 87%-91% rating) down to just 'Mixed in the most recent reviews'. The impact on the team has been devastating. 😭😭😭

[b]It was all fair though as the bugs were significant and we agree that this is unacceptable![/b]
So over this week the team has worked above and beyond. We have even had to encourage them to be careful about taking time to stop and rest. But their commitment to trying to fix all the problems has been amazing - we are so grateful to them. [b]This is a labor of love[/b] for us all and you, the players, deserve to have a game which delivers on its promised experience. 

We are determined to get this right and to regain your faith in us - hopefully convert a few of those reviews back to positive.  We have so much more planned in our future roadmap with new seasonal content, new missions, deeper bonds with the creatures and characters, etc etc.

[b]We can now report that we believe we have solved all of the biggest issues.[/b] The temptation is to release this immediately but that would be a mistake.  We need to make sure it has been tested extensively. It is imperative that we confirm that the fixes are out and that we haven’t accidentally introduced more issues. 

For those of you who don't want to wait and want to be part of the process of checking, [b]we have created a beta branch for you to try out[/b]. No expectations! And, obviously, we appreciate the support from anyone willing to take a look! 

To access the beta branch click here (and don’t forget our discord channel):

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1550730/discussions/1/6699728899096294329/

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/0a80df08515f7328a0eb9567ab5ffda3b98bb492.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[b][h1]🏝️ Hey Castaways!! 🏝️[/h1][/b]

As you may have noticed we launched 🚀on Thursday and there have been a bunch of mixed reviews due to a bunch of bugs, glitches, and imperfections🐞over this weekend. First off, we want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who reported these issues 🙏 

We are glad to say that the majority of players seem to be having a great time, based on the reviews, but we appreciate that even if this is only affecting a few people it’s not good enough. We feel really bad that anyone had problems like this and we are going to deal with this head on.
Here are some of the issues raised:
[list]
[*] “Losing connection to host” - Whilst the game does use online tools so we can provide content updates and events, this shouldn't be affecting your ability to play solo. We are looking into why this has happened and will get this fixed ASAP. 
[*] “Bug which reverts areas of the map back to their original state - e.g. restoring barriers” - This should not be happening obviously.
[*]  “Need to have an Epic Account” - you do not need an epic account but on rare occasions a small number of users seem to get stuck in a loop where they don’t seem to be able to skip this. 
[*] Key Binding bug - some users have stated that they have had issues where changing the controls fails to save properly. E.g. when switching from QWERTY to AZERTY Keyboard layouts.
[/list]
Our team is already hard at work, working out what has caused these issues and getting you a hot-fix in the next few days. 🔨⚙️ 
Rest assured, we're treating this seriously and with the utmost urgency, we know you all deserve a smooth gaming experience! We will do better!
Additionally, we have had some comments about some elements of the game we also want to fix that includes:
[list]
[*] Ability to Pause the Game - currently you can only Save & Quit
[*] Onboarding - some people aren’t hitting the information/unlocks intended making for them the process seem slow and confusing
[*] Some of our hints and guides seems to be too subtle
[/list]
We are working on these issues now and hope you will bear with us. 
Your support means the world to us! 🌐🚀

Sincerely

Bendik

[h3][b]👥 Multiplayer[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam and Epic Cross-Play added! More Cross-Play coming at a later time. 
[/list]
[h3][b]💯 Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the Input in the game to be more user-friendly.
[*] All late-game Plants now mature faster.
[*] Streamlined how saving and loading are handled in the main menu
[/list]
[h3][b]🍃 Flow[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the beginning of the game
[*] The game now starts at a different location.
[*] The Hammer and Hatchet tutorial is now combined and appears after you’ve fixed the first Shrine.
[*] The Combat Tutorial has been moved to after you reach the Hamlet.
[*] Improved the starting path to better guide the player towards the Hamlet.
[*] Thorn Bushes can no longer be destroyed by swords.
[*] Building the Tree House and the rooms inside it are now cheaper.
[*] The Gardening Chest should be easier to find.
[*] The Tree House can no longer be acquired as a placeable item. A permanent Tree House is located in the area where Sariel teaches you how to create a garden.
[*] Frogboy jumps away right after introducing the S.E.L.L. Chest. Find him in the Froglet Grove to buy the Tent.
[*] Sariel now opens her shop earlier than before.
[*] Some items, like the Frog House, should now be available in Frogboy’s Shop earlier.
[/list]
[h3][b]👀 Visuals[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Scholar Statues has an updated visual to be easier to see. It also starts glowing when you place a Frog on it to unlock that part of the map.
[*] Updated Achievement, Companion Level, and Quest Icons.
[*] New 4K loading screens implemented
[*] New and improved visuals for the Daily Summary Screen.
[/list]
[h3][b]💃 Animation[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Sitting Animations for each object the player can sit on.
[*] Combat
[*] Updated size and color of the monsters of the island to better showcase their power level
[*] Removed the Amri Root connected to Monster Spawners on the island. 
[*] Monsters Spawned by Monster Spawners are stronger than before.
[*] Added more places for monsters to naturally spawn on the island.
[/list]
[h3][b]🌻 Resource Gathering[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Economy Update[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple items have had their Sell and Buy prices adjusted.
[*] Valuable items have a chance to drop from multiple new sources.
[*] Ribbits can now be found when cutting Tall Grass.
[*] Digging gives more Sand in the Desert Dunes and Dawning Sands, and more Snow in the Sunless Horn. 
[*] Fishing Nodes should now spawn more frequently in Fenland Point.
[*] Ribbits can now be auto-picked up.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]🖥️ GUI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The Buy Button is now greyed out when selecting an item in a shop that you can’t afford.
[*] The Health Bar in the inventory screen is now below the player’s name.
[*] The list of players playing is now only visible when more than one player is playing.
[*] Sell Value is now visible on the description text of items that can be sold.
[*] Icons for cycling through the Item Bars should now be more visible.
[*] Added a button on the Title Screen for easy access to our other available games.
[*] Updated animation showing Ribbits gained and lost.
[*] Added notice and solution prompt for fixing corrupted saves.
[/list]
[h3][b]🎶 Audio[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Mixing Updates on music and general audio
[/list]
[h3][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue causing Shop Preview to still be present after an NPC moved away from that location.
[*] Fixed areas where the companion would get stuck while following the player.
[*] C.A.T. should no longer be flying in the Workshop and should use the correct Idle Animation.
[*] Fixed the issue causing some players to fall through the ground in the Sanctuary.
[*] Fixed the issue causing a region on the map to not update.
[*] Fixed the issue causing C.A.T. to stop having interesting things to say.
[*] Fixed an issue where the characters would sit in strange angles.
[*] Fixed multiple areas where the player could get stuck.
[*] Fixed misaligned text in the Friends List.
[*] Fixed jittering text in the Crafting Menu.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the main quest to stop progressing if the player never talked to Frogboy after creating the Bottle O’ Wind.
[*] Fixed issue causing multiple items to never appear in Frogboy’s Shop.
[*] Fixed issue where C.A.T. returns to standing idle in the shop.
[*] Reduced the movement in the grass during strong winds.
[*] Fixed issue causing a sub-region in the island to not be visible on the map.
[*] The screen should no longer go to black before the Daily Summary Screen is displayed when going to sleep in interiors.
[*] Fixed visible seams in the landscape.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck on a perpetual loading screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could press buttons on the main menu before it was loaded.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would get soft-lock if the player disconnected a controller while loading into the game.
[*] Fixed a saving and loading issue with the Scholar Statues.
[*] Fixed an issue where repeated saving and loading would expand the inventory size.

You just need to make a "Ribbit Request" (a Join Code) to be able to join in the same game session together. Oh! And IMPORTANT! Ensure everyone who tries to play the co-op is using the latest updates - otherwise, you may unfortunately risk experiencing crashes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/6acae334bcbe78a645978f092b7fea9531b42ba7.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Hello There, Castaways! 🏝️[/b][/h1]

After tending to your crops, you decide to go for a walk on the beach with your critter friend. It runs past you, jumping, while you crouch to pick some frogs.

You hear your furry companion making noises, trying to alert you. But as you raise your head to check on it, you bump it into something and fall backwards.

What was that? As you stare forward, you see a wooden chest opening up. Your lil' pal stands by your side looking anxiously at it. On it, there's a plaque that reads:

[h3][b]Ikonei Island's First Major Update![/b][/h3]

You get up, approach the chest and stare inside. Here's what you see!

[h2][b]🐸 Huge Creature Pass[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/feaef9cff527d37432e311c95357c07fde3e2c02.gif[/img]

[i]Companions can now be commanded to perform their actions! Bonding is no longer required, but still possible.[/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/b5cb2c1fe068c6f5061173ec3d5558302c50034c.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/3f941eded95ca6cda8a7b4f9fb02ac038a9d65b3.gif[/img]
[i]Creatures can now be fed, washed, and played with to increase their mood and experience bar![/i]

[*] Improved locomotion animations for all companions (Stormdog, Otterlot, Longhorn, Axepecker, and Bibi);

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/86d4dc5e3d65aa2b559c5fdbde3b017759d2ddf8.gif[/img]
[i]You can use the crops on your farm to do all kinds of things, like restore health, feed your creatures or make some profit. To this end, we wanted to make sure that farming felt easy and fluid to do. 
Orientation of tilled ground should now feel even better, and it will be easy to design your farm however you want![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/614414028ab7b80c5bc28a3f296f9f517b3531d4.gif[/img]

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/da2402890ca1b58e7ca6c93b224184b183cb9148.png[/img]

[h1]Hello there, Castaways! 🏝️[/h1]

Today we've got some awesome news to share with you: [url=https://www.gamescom.global/en/gamescom/gamescom-award]Ikonei Island has been nominated for the Best Family Game award at gamescom 2022[/url]!!!

This is huge for us and we want to share our excitement with you, our amazing supporters, and tell you all about it!

[h2]Gamescom? 🎮[/h2]

Gamescom is a trade fair for videogames held annually at the Koelnmesse in Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It's the world's largest gaming event (measured by exhibition space and the number of visitors), with +370K visitors and 1153 exhibitors attending the show in 2019, and 13M digital attendees in 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42051469/852d8918da18f6149d6005dc1c9467fc6a1865a8.jpg[/img]
[i]Not your average videogame fair![/i]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]The Award 🏅[/h2]

The games submitted for the gamescom award are assessed by an independent and internationally staffed jury of around 30 experts from the gaming industry. Their ranking takes into consideration 7 fixed criteria: graphics, gameplay, sound, entertainment, technological progress, and sales prospects.
With the Best Family Game gamescom award, the jury honors 3 videogames that invite children and their parents to have fun. And we made it into one of these nominees!

Now we are crossing our fingers and waiting for the results 🤞
